contractsVerified: Independent wheel-editor/1 plane; loopback-only; authenticates configured client token, project path/ID, protocol/plane and fresh editor session; no first-connector trust
Public EditorInterface queries read actual edited scene, owner/parent tree, dirty scenes, selection and filesystem on main thread; no private Inspector or runtime substitute
Missing/disabled editor returns ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE; authorization disabled/foreign client denied; version/identity/plane mismatch rejects
Main-thread bounded queue reports CONFLICT, invalid limits, TIMEOUT and same-peer cancellation acknowledgement; client abort reports REQUESTED_NOT_CONFIRMED and ignores late reads
Plugin disable closes queued reads/peers/listener and removes only its endpoint/lease; re-enable changes session; actual second editor cannot replace live endpoint
Malformed/oversized request frames and linked private metadata reject; response frame/schema/identity budgets enforced
Official SDK InMemory and actual stdio entry enforce transport-bound read/project authorization; args cannot override owner; MCP shutdown leaves editor alive
Five-domain registration retained; exact 60 tools, read-only/non-destructive annotations and MCP-only CLI decision verified; old tools invoked successfully after registration fix
Scene contents and project plugin configuration are not modified by product reads; only fixture controller deliberately changes test plugin enablement

SDK overloaded tool() treated empty annotations as a schema/callback. Replaced wrapper internals with public registerTool config API; authorization/lifecycle wrapping retained; added legacy tool invocation assertion

Cleanup fixture occupied global queue from another peer; Node reads legitimately got CONFLICT, not queued work. Removed competing batch; wait for first real read before disable, then assert remaining pending reads become ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE

limitations: Only Windows/Godot 4.7.2 stable real editor validated; Linux/macOS and desktop renderer/UI NOT_RUN
Read-only scene snapshot, not resource dirty tracking, native scene mutation, Undo/Redo or save/reopen validation (T12-T15 pending)
Opt-in is manual/private configuration, fixtures are scripted; actual human client confirmation NOT_RUN
Not an OS sandbox; malicious local process/config/plugin changes and path TOCTOU outside protection
Unclean editor exit may leave endpoint/lease; refuse takeover until project owner verifies exit and removes only stale editor metadata; no PID-based automatic kill
Authorization changes require plugin disable/re-enable; already authenticated connections do not hot-reload config
Raw runs are local Git-ignored evidence; rerun after transfer if unavailable. No commit, push, publishing or deployment
